}}'''Julanya Fote''' is one of the [[Kin]].

== Appearance ==
She is plump and pretty with touches of white in her dark hair.

==Strength and Abilities==
In "The Wheel of Time Companion" her level of strength is described as {{opsl|22}}. In the same entry it is stated that she could make a gateway just large enough to pass through. Usually a strength as {{opsl|22}} is more than enough to open suitable gateways to [[Travel]] (in fact the minimum strength required is usually around level {{opsl|28}}) so maybe Julanya is lacking more in [[Talent]] than in strength.

== Activities ==
Due to ability to [[Travel]], she is sent to report on what the [[Borderlands]] army is doing. She is then told to watch and report on any movement the neutral [[High Seat]]s armies may make.

She [[Travel]]s back to [[Caemlyn]] to report to [[Birgitte Silverbow]] that the army is moving towards the city. She is sent back to their camp to work as a laundress.

Julanya helps douse fires caused by the ''[[Gholam]]'' attack on [[Matrim Cauthon]] back in [[Caemlyn]].
